title: CreditSupportObligationsVariationMargin
description: A class to specify the Credit Support Obligations applicable to the Variation Margin Credit Support Annex.

ineligibleCreditSupport.description: The parties to which the provisions of the Credit Support Annex for Variation Margin will apply to.

majorCurrency.description: The additional currencies that are specified as Major Currency for the purpose of applying the FX Haircut Percentage.

fxHaircut.description: The alternative definition for FX haircut percentage that applies to each party and item of Eligible Collateral unless this item is denominated in a Major Currency or in the Base Currency.
